note: On-air rewrites for ticker stories, keyed by ticker id. Short conversational reads plus W's and sources.

loc-53c0b4f63a.read: Big change downtown this year: Traverse City split the holiday kickoff into two nights. Tonight is the tree lighting, and tomorrow night is the Light Parade. The city says it's about crowds and safety. Last year they crammed both into one Saturday and it was packed.
loc-53c0b4f63a.who: Downtown Development Authority + Traverse City Police
loc-53c0b4f63a.what: Tree lighting and Light Parade split into two nights
loc-53c0b4f63a.why: Public feedback, crowd control and safety

loc-eaef81756b.read: Heads up if you're headed downtown tomorrow. The Light Parade means Front Street closes from Franklin to Pine, 3 to 8 PM. Side streets in the staging area close too, so give yourself extra time or take another way around.
loc-eaef81756b.what: Road closures for the Light Parade
loc-eaef81756b.where: Front St between Franklin and Pine, plus the staging area

loc-b5bfd2bb47.read: A bestselling romance author posted about Horizon Books in downtown TC, and now the phones won't stop ringing. Abby Jimenez's daughter goes to Interlochen, she gives the store a shout-out, and suddenly people all over the country want signed copies shipped from Front Street.
loc-b5bfd2bb47.what: Nationwide rush on signed books after her posts
loc-b5bfd2bb47.why: Her daughter attends Interlochen Arts Academy, and she posts about TC to millions of fans

loc-8afce78769.read: Good news story: an 83-year-old hunter who'd been missing for two days was found alive. Search crews on the ground heard him calling for help. Two days out there in November, at 83. That's one tough guy.
loc-8afce78769.what: Found alive after two days missing
loc-8afce78769.why: Rescuers heard him calling for help

loc-4509eb43c3.read: Feel-good one: the Old Mission Peninsula Women's Club packed Thanksgiving baskets for 12 local families. Each one has everything for a full turkey dinner, plus paper towels, pans and breakfast stuff, and they get dropped off through the schools.
loc-4509eb43c3.where: Grand Traverse County, through local schools
loc-4509eb43c3.why: Help families in need have a full holiday meal

loc-8f13e32547.read: You'll start hearing the bells. The Salvation Army's Red Kettle campaign is underway in Petoskey, and they're saying the need is up this year. Drop your change in, or sign up for a shift ringing.
loc-8f13e32547.who: Salvation Army Petoskey, Majors Brian and Heidi Reed

loc-1cb33d9091.read: Charlevoix County needs a new sheriff. Sheriff Chuck Vondra is retiring December 1st, and whoever they pick serves through 2028. If nobody's in place by then, the undersheriff fills in.
loc-1cb33d9091.what: Retiring, county searching for a replacement
loc-1cb33d9091.when: Retirement effective Dec 1; successor serves to Dec 31, 2028

loc-e51460cb9d.read: New hiking spot up north: the 19-acre Bates Preserve in Charlevoix County, with trails through old beech-maple forest. It connects to two other preserves for 67 acres total, so it's a good walk to work off the turkey next week.
loc-e51460cb9d.why: Links up with two other protected areas, 67 acres total

loc-38a92c81cc.read: Finally: the Up North river crossing that washed out in the spring flooding is open to traffic again. If you've been taking the long way around since spring, you can stop.

loc-2a5ba8f1d1.read: Benzie County's food pantry says Thanksgiving week is slammed, with more families asking for help than usual. If you're doing a food drive or have extra cans in the pantry, this is the week it counts.
loc-2a5ba8f1d1.what: Thanksgiving-week rush, more families seeking help
loc-2a5ba8f1d1.why: Rising need ahead of the holiday
